Inside George Michael’s Lost Album with Andros Georgiou | XS Noize Podcast #296

August 18, 2026 XS Noize Podcast
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:21
Instaread

In this episode of the XS Noize Podcast, host Mark Millar is joined by Andros Georgiou to discuss his lifelong friendship with George Michael and reveal the remarkable story behind Trojan Souls—the ambitious album that was never completed.

Watch the full interview

Andros grew up alongside George and knew him long before fame arrived. He recalls recognising George’s extraordinary musical ability at an early age, the bond that kept them close and what George was really like away from the public spotlight.

The conversation revisits Boogie Box High and its cover of the Bee Gees’ “Jive Talkin’,” which featured an uncredited lead vocal from George. Andros explains how the project came together and why George enjoyed making music without his name dominating the release.

Andros also tells the story of Trojan Souls, an ambitious album conceived during studio sessions in Los Angeles in the early 1990s. The project brought together an extraordinary line-up that included George Michael, Elton John, Stevie Wonder, Aretha Franklin, Janet Jackson, Seal, Sade and Bryan Ferry.

He discusses recording “This Kind of Love” with George and Elton John, how much of the album was completed and why the project was ultimately placed on hold. Andros also reveals what may remain in the original tape archive and where Trojan Souls could have fitted within George’s catalogue.

The episode offers a fascinating insight into George’s approach to songwriting and production. Andros remembers watching him build songs inside the studio and describes hearing “Praying for Time” for the first time.

Andros also explains why he released his personal footage of George in the Trojan Souls film, the reaction it received and the importance of allowing people to see a side of George that was rarely captured publicly.

The conversation also explores their pioneering work with Aegean.net, what people still misunderstand about George and the qualities that made him laugh. In the episode’s most personal moments, Andros remembers their final conversation and shares his most treasured memory of his lifelong friend.

Watch “Trojan Souls – The Greatest Album That Was Never Made” at trojansouls.com

Listen to the podcast

Listen and subscribe to The XS Noize Podcast on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, YouTube or wherever you get your podcasts.

In this episode, Andros Georgiou discusses:

* Growing up with George Michael
* Recognising George’s musical talent at an early age
* Boogie Box High and the story behind “Jive Talkin’”
* How the Trojan Souls project began
* Bringing together its extraordinary collection of artists
* Recording “This Kind of Love” with George Michael and Elton John
* George’s unique songwriting and production process
* Hearing “Praying for Time” for the first time
* How much of Trojan Souls was completed
* Returning to the original recordings
* Releasing his personal studio footage of George
* George Michael, Andros and Aegean.net
* What people still misunderstand about George
* Their emotional final conversation
* Andros’s most treasured memory of George

About The XS Noize Podcast

The XS Noize Podcast features in-depth conversations with the artists, musicians and creative figures who shape our culture. Hosted by XS Noize founder and editor Mark Millar, the podcast explores the stories behind the music—from landmark albums and career-defining moments to the experiences that inspire the songs.
